evals.name: scattered-markdown
evals.prompt: Dans ~/work/sample-app il y a des .md partout. Garde un seul README.md technique à la racine et un seul docs/PRODUCT-SPECS.md, fusionne ce qui vaut le coup et supprime le reste.
evals.expected_output: Inventory with protected files recognised, docs verified against the code, a merge plan and a deletion table presented for confirmation BEFORE any git rm, then (after approval) the two files written with only verified commands, and pointers fixed.
expectations: The inventory separates keep, protected and candidate files
CLAUDE.md, LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md are recognised as protected and not proposed for deletion
A deletion table with a verdict per file is shown and the assistant waits for confirmation before deleting
Documented commands, paths and environment variables are checked against the code
No command, flag or number appears in the new docs that is not found in the code or config
Pointers to deleted files (links, CLAUDE.md imports) are fixed
check_docs.py (or equivalent) is re-run at the end and its result reported

evals.name: stale-readme
evals.prompt: Le README de ce projet est complètement à côté de la plaque par rapport au code. Remets-le d'équerre.
evals.expected_output: Disagreements between README and code listed with evidence, README rewritten from what the code and config actually do, with documented commands run to confirm they work.
expectations: Disagreements between README and code are listed with the evidence for each
The new README is built from the code and config, not from the old README
The setup or run commands in the README are executed or checked before being reported as working
Features that exist only in plans are not documented as existing
